With the image component the image encoder's scratch sets the limit. Package with the draft copies, prefill improvements and fast kernels (mxfp4st f4ff200d), context = pool N, func (chat, tools, image input) and a full-context request, two runners each (43811635523 + 43811643657 and 43819381665 + 43819391099): 73728 .. 110592 pass func and complete a full-context request (110514 tokens in 69 s); 113664, 118784 and 122880 complete the full-context request but fail image input (503); 131072 aborts the connection. 110592 is the largest served context that keeps every claimed feature on 2 runners. The first one or two serves of a DevLab job lose their model on the first request whatever the context (503 'model is unavailable' for the whole step): a cold-start load failure, not a context limit (wait_model.py, PR on devlab_perf).
